Lord '''Lor'themar Theron''' is the last known living member of [[House Theron]] and a current member of the [[Regency Council]] of [[Alah'Thalas]].

==Biography==
Lor'themar was raised by his uncle [[Vanthalir'il Theron|Vanthalir'il]], who acted as both guardian and mentor.<ref name="House of Theron" />

===Mysteries of Azeroth===
Lor'themar later joined the greater [[Silvermoon Remnant]] as the high elves began to resettle the region of the [[Thalassian Highlands]]. Lor'themar, as a prominent surviving noble, was granted a place as part of the new [[Regency Council]] when [[Vereesa Windrunner]] was deposed by the remaining nobility as Speaker for the Remnant. However, Lor'themar remained a supporter of Vereesa.

Lor'themar's uncle and guardian, Vanthalir'il, was found to have perished upon the Highlands and returned from beyond the grave. His uncle's signet was returned to him to signify that he had been returned to his rest.<ref name="House of Theron" />

Upon hearing that the [[Wildhammer dwarves]] of the [[Grim Reaches]] were facing a perilous plight, Lor'themar sent a detachment of rangers led by [[Faellina Swiftstride]] to aid the people of [[Dun Kithas]] and honor the high elves' old alliances with the Wildhammers.<ref>{{questlong|Alliance|34|Honoring Old Alliances}}</ref> In addition, he tasked the rangers with locating a means to cure the [[withered]] of Quel'Thalas that he believed may be hidden within the depths of [[Grim Batol]].<ref>{{questlong|Alliance|36|To Cure the Withered}}</ref>

Despite ostensibly being a supporter to Vereesa, Lor'themar was the one who had told Lord [[Astalor Sunsworn]] of the [[Silver Covenant]] diverting supplies to fund their second attack on [[Shalandis Isle]], and voted for Lord Sunsworn when he made a motion before the Council to be named Lord-Regent of Quel'Thalas in the aftermath of the Silver Covenant's campaign.<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=u90BCZfygz0 A GOOD DAY — Everlook Broadcasting Co. Radio Play Series]</ref>
